happening.text: A delver comes up the moor road to Barrowmere and takes the watch the last warden can no longer stand alone.

npc/hedric.doing: Keeping the gate yard with his weight off the bad knee, sizing up whoever it is Maren has sent for.

npc/maren.doing: Standing her post at the inner gate, reciting the vigil's oaths under her breath while she waits to be relieved of them.

happening.text: Hedric, who cannot walk the halls himself any more, gives up the shield he has polished every night for twenty years.
happening.subject: item/hedrics-shield

happening.text: Maren speaks the charge in full — quiet the halls, take back the barrow key, unbar the deep door, and end the vigil at the altar.
happening.subject: npc/maren

happening.text: The inner gate's iron bars grind up for the first time in a decade, and the halls beyond stand open.
happening.subject: anchor/gate

happening.text: Maren speaks the summons, and the hollow garrison answers it — climbing out of the barrow-earth into the halls it once held.
happening.subject: wave/hollow-garrison

happening.text: The keep is taken back one room at a time, against men who wore its colours before anyone now alive was born.

npc/hedric.doing: Holding the gate yard, listening to the fighting inside and hating every step he cannot take.

barks: That's the way — shield up, mind your left!
Twenty years I carried that shield. Don't you dare bleed on it.
I'd be down there beside you if the knee would have it.

npc/maren.doing: Watching the halls she called the dead into, naming each footman under her breath as he falls.

barks: That one was Aldis. He kept the west stair for thirty years.
Do not apologise to them. They stopped being mine a long time ago.
Quiet them all. Then the key.

objectives.title: Quiet the Halls
objectives.hint: Maren's summons has drawn the hollow garrison out of the barrow-earth — hunt down every risen footman in the halls beyond the gate.

happening.text: The last hollow footman goes down, and Barrowmere is quiet for the first time since the summons.
happening.subject: wave/hollow-garrison

happening.text: What the garrison was set to guard stops being a rumour in the founding scrolls and becomes a door with a key that fits it.

npc/hedric.doing: Talking the delver through a strongbox he has never seen, because talking is the only part of the work left to him.

barks: A strongbox, she said. Garrison kept everything in strongboxes.
Deep door's the one under the lantern. You'll not miss it.
Key in your hand, mind — that door won't take a promise.

npc/maren.doing: Waiting at the gate for a door she was forbidden her whole life to open, and has now ordered opened.

barks: The key was struck the same year the order was. It will fit.
The deep door has not opened in my lifetime. Be ready for what kept it shut.
The key. Then the door. Then the altar.

objectives.title: Take the Barrow Key
objectives.hint: The garrison's strongbox holds the barrow key — look for the chest in a small side room.

happening.text: The garrison's strongbox gives up the barrow key, struck the same year the order was sworn.
happening.subject: item/barrow-key

objectives.title: Unlock the Deep Door
objectives.hint: The deep door waits in the corner room — the glowing lantern marks it. Hold the barrow key and open it.

happening.text: The deep door comes unbarred, and two hundred years of not knowing what stands behind it end.
happening.subject: anchor/door

happening.text: The First Warden takes notice of the open door and rises from his post to meet whoever opened it.
happening.subject: wave/first-warden

happening.text: The order gets the ending Maren wanted for it, rather than the abandonment it was drifting toward.

npc/hedric.doing: Standing in the gate yard with nothing left to hand over, waiting to see who comes back out.

barks: He's still down there. He was always still down there.
Come back out of there. That's the whole of what I'm asking.

npc/maren.doing: Refusing to go down and watch it done, which is the last thing about the vigil she is ashamed of.

barks: He is the First Warden. He is also my blood. Do it anyway.
The ending is two lines: the watch was kept, the watch is done.
I will not come down there. Forgive me that.

objectives.title: Break the First Warden
objectives.hint: He stands his post in the great hall with a footman at his side. He still carries his blade — bring your shield up.

happening.text: The First Warden is put down at the post he took two hundred years ago and never once left.
happening.subject: wave/first-warden

objectives.title: Speak the Ending
objectives.hint: Step up to the altar at the head of the great hall, past where the First Warden fell.

happening.text: The delver steps up to the barrow altar, onto flagstones the founder wore hollow standing on them.
happening.subject: anchor/objective

happening.text: The ending is spoken over the altar and the vigil closes — kept to the last, and finally released.
happening.subject: anchor/objective
